consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Rule (f) is derived per FILE: every member below mutates src/commands/doctor.ts, which spawns `git check-ignore -q` to reach its other retention verdicts, so the capture obligation binds even though the arms these tests guard return BEFORE that spawn. The citation is load-bearing rather than ceremonial: the tests assert that none of the three verdicts downstream of the git-consulting loop (git-ignored, does not exist, present and tracked) appears in the not-applicable line, and the capture is where those verdicts' external contract is recorded (ignored 0, unignored 1, outside a repository 128, git 2.43.0, 2026-08-13). THREE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT MEMBERS, one per direction the collapse can be made now that `full` promotes both conditions and the cheapest tidy-up is to make them one. Member 0 makes the charterless arm print the undeclared sentence and carry the undeclared id. Member 1 makes the undeclared arm print the charterless sentence. Member 2 edits neither message: it defeats the branch condition, so one arm becomes unreachable and both states take the other, which is the collapse an author would reach for first.
